title: NFL Football
description:
New York Giants at Washington Commanders
The Washington Commanders host the New York Giants in NFL Week 5 at Northwest Stadium. The Giants lead the NFC East and have won three of their last four games, but Washington has taken four of the last five meetings between these division rivals.

description:
